verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַבַּצָּרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū ‘al- diḇ·rê hab·baṣ·ṣā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning . . . the drought
verses.literalPt: A PALAVRA do SENHOR, que veio a Jeremias, a respeito da grande seca.

verses.original: אָבְלָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה וּשְׁעָרֶ֥יהָ אֻמְלְל֖וּ קָדְר֣וּ לָאָ֑רֶץ וְצִוְחַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עָלָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇə·lāh yə·hū·ḏāh ū·šə·‘ā·re·hā ’um·lə·lū qā·ḏə·rū lā·’ā·reṣ wə·ṣiw·ḥaṯ yə·rū·šā·lim ‘ā·lā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Judah mourns and her gates languish Her people wail for the land and a cry goes up from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Anda chorando Judá, e as suas portas estão enfraquecidas; andam de luto até ao chão, e o clamor de Jerusalém vai subindo.

verses.original: וְאַדִּ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם שָׁלְח֥וּ צְעוֹרֵיהֶם לַמָּ֑יִם בָּ֣אוּ עַל־ גֵּבִ֞ים לֹא־ מָ֣צְאוּ מַ֗יִם שָׁ֤בוּ כְלֵיהֶם֙ רֵיקָ֔ם בֹּ֥שׁוּ וְהָכְלְמ֖וּ וְחָפ֥וּ רֹאשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ad·di·rê·hem šā·lə·ḥū ṣə·ʿō·rē·hɛm lam·mā·yim bā·’ū ‘al- gê·ḇîm lō- mā·ṣə·’ū ma·yim šā·ḇū ḵə·lê·hem rê·qām bō·šū wə·hā·ḵə·lə·mū wə·ḥā·p̄ū rō·šām
verses.literal: The nobles send their servants for water they go to the cisterns but find no water their jars return empty They are ashamed and humiliated they cover their heads
verses.literalPt: E os seus mais ilustres enviam os seus pequenos a buscar água; vão às cisternas, e não acham água; voltam com os seus cântaros vazios; envergonham-se e confundem-se, e cobrem as suas cabeças.

verses.original: בַּעֲב֤וּר הָאֲדָמָה֙ חַ֔תָּה כִּ֛י לֹא־ הָיָ֥ה גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּאָ֑רֶץ בֹּ֥שׁוּ אִכָּרִ֖ים חָפ֥וּ רֹאשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ḥat·tāh kî lō- hā·yāh ḡe·šem bā·’ā·reṣ bō·šū ’ik·kā·rîm ḥā·p̄ū rō·šām
verses.literal: The ground is cracked because no . . . rain has fallen on the land The farmers are ashamed they cover their heads
verses.literalPt: Por causa da terra que se fendeu, porque não há chuva sobre a terra, os lavradores se envergonham e cobrem as suas cabeças.

verses.original: כִּ֤י גַם־ אַיֶּ֙לֶת֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יָלְדָ֖ה וְעָז֑וֹב כִּ֥י לֹֽא־ הָיָ֖ה דֶּֽשֶׁא׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḡam- ’ay·ye·leṯ baś·śā·ḏeh yā·lə·ḏāh wə·‘ā·zō·wḇ kî lō- hā·yāh de·še
verses.literal: Even . . . the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass
verses.literalPt: Porque até as cervas no campo têm as suas crias, e abandonam seus filhos, porquanto não há erva.

verses.original: וּפְרָאִים֙ עָמְד֣וּ עַל־ שְׁפָיִ֔ם שָׁאֲפ֥וּ ר֖וּחַ כַּתַּנִּ֑ים כָּל֥וּ עֵינֵיהֶ֖ם כִּי־ אֵ֥ין עֵֽשֶׂב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·rā·’îm ‘ā·mə·ḏū ‘al- šə·p̄ā·yim šā·’ă·p̄ū rū·aḥ kat·tan·nîm kā·lū ‘ê·nê·hem kî- ’ên ‘ê·śeḇ
verses.literal: Wild donkeys stand on barren heights they pant for air like jackals their eyes fail for lack of pasture
verses.literalPt: E os jumentos monteses se põem nos lugares altos, sorvem o vento como os chacais; desfalecem os seus olhos, porquanto não há erva.

verses.original: אִם־ עֲוֺנֵ֙ינוּ֙ עָ֣נוּ בָ֔נוּ יְהוָ֕ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ רַבּ֥וּ מְשׁוּבֹתֵ֖ינוּ לְךָ֥ חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ‘ă·wō·nê·nū ‘ā·nū ḇā·nū Yah·weh ‘ă·śêh lə·ma·‘an šə·me·ḵā kî- rab·bū mə·šū·ḇō·ṯê·nū lə·ḵā ḥā·ṭā·nū
verses.literal: Although our iniquities testify against us O LORD act for the sake of Your name Indeed our rebellions are many we have sinned against You
verses.literalPt: Posto que as nossas maldades testificam contra nós, ó SENHOR, age por amor do teu nome; porque as nossas rebeldias se multiplicaram; contra ti pecamos.

verses.original: מִקְוֵה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֽוֹשִׁיע֖וֹ בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָ֑ה לָ֤מָּה תִֽהְיֶה֙ כְּגֵ֣ר בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּכְאֹרֵ֖חַ נָטָ֥ה לָלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: miq·wêh yiś·rā·’êl mō·wō·šî·‘ōw bə·‘êṯ ṣā·rāh lām·māh ṯih·yeh kə·ḡêr bā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḵə·’ō·rê·aḥ nā·ṭāh lā·lūn
verses.literal: O Hope of Israel its Savior in times of distress why are You like a stranger in the land like a traveler who stays but a night . . .
verses.literalPt: Ó esperança de Israel, e Redentor seu no tempo da angústia, por que serias como um estrangeiro na terra e como o viandante que se retira a passar a noite?

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה תִֽהְיֶה֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ נִדְהָ֔ם כְּגִבּ֖וֹר לֹא־ יוּכַ֣ל לְהוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְאַתָּ֧ה בְקִרְבֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֗ה וְשִׁמְךָ֛ עָלֵ֥ינוּ נִקְרָ֖א אַל־ תַּנִּחֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṯih·yeh kə·’îš niḏ·hām kə·ḡib·bō·wr lō- yū·ḵal lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ wə·’at·tāh ḇə·qir·bê·nū Yah·weh wə·šim·ḵā ‘ā·lê·nū niq·rā ’al- tan·ni·ḥê·nū
verses.literal: Why are You like a man taken by surprise like a warrior powerless to save Yet You are among us O LORD and we are called by Your name . . . Do not forsake us
verses.literalPt: Por que serias como homem surpreendido, como poderoso que não pode livrar? Mas tu estás no meio de nós, ó SENHOR, e nós somos chamados pelo teu nome; não nos desampares.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה כֵּ֤ן אָֽהֲבוּ֙ לָנ֔וּעַ רַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א חָשָׂ֑כוּ וַיהוָה֙ לֹ֣א רָצָ֔ם עַתָּה֙ יִזְכֹּ֣ר עֲוֺנָ֔ם וְיִפְקֹ֖ד חַטֹּאתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh lā·‘ām haz·zeh kên ’ā·hă·ḇū lā·nū·a‘ raḡ·lê·hem lō ḥā·śā·ḵū Yah·weh lō rā·ṣām ‘at·tāh yiz·kōr ‘ă·wō·nām wə·yip̄·qōḏ ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯām
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says about this people Truly they love to wander they have not restrained their feet So the LORD does not accept them He will now remember their iniquity and punish them for their sins
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR, acerca deste povo: Pois que tanto gostaram de andar errantes, e não retiveram os seus pés, por isso o SENHOR não se agrada deles, mas agora se lembrará da iniqüidade deles, e visitará os seus pecados.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י אַל־ תִּתְפַּלֵּ֛ל בְּעַד־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה לְטוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāy ’al- tiṯ·pal·lêl bə·‘aḏ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Do not pray for the well-being of this people
verses.literalPt: Disse-me mais o SENHOR: Não rogues por este povo para seu bem.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָצֻ֗מוּ אֵינֶ֤נִּי שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ אֶל־ רִנָּתָ֔ם וְכִ֧י יַעֲל֛וּ עֹלָ֥ה וּמִנְחָ֖ה אֵינֶ֣נִּי רֹצָ֑ם כִּ֗י בַּחֶ֙רֶב֙ וּבָרָעָ֣ב וּבַדֶּ֔בֶר אָנֹכִ֖י מְכַלֶּ֥ה אוֹתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî yā·ṣu·mū ’ê·nen·nî šō·mê·a‘ ’el- rin·nā·ṯām wə·ḵî ya·‘ă·lū ‘ō·lāh ū·min·ḥāh ’ê·nen·nî rō·ṣām kî ba·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇā·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇad·de·ḇer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ḵal·leh ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Although they may fast I will not listen to . . . their cry although they may offer burnt offerings and grain offerings I will not accept them Instead I will finish them off by sword and famine and plague
verses.literalPt: Quando jejuarem, não ouvirei o seu clamor, e quando oferecerem holocaustos e ofertas de alimentos, não me agradarei deles; antes eu os consumirei pela espada, e pela fome e pela peste.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֞ר אֲהָ֣הּ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה הַנְּבִאִ֜ים אֹמְרִ֤ים לָהֶם֙ לֹֽא־ תִרְא֣וּ חֶ֔רֶב וְרָעָ֖ב לֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ שְׁל֤וֹם אֱמֶת֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nêh han·nə·ḇi·’îm ’ō·mə·rîm lā·hem lō- ṯir·’ū ḥe·reḇ wə·rā·‘āḇ lō- yih·yeh lā·ḵem kî- šə·lō·wm ’ĕ·meṯ ’et·tên lā·ḵem bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Ah Lord GOD I replied Look the prophets are telling them You will not see the sword or suffer famine . . . but I will give you lasting peace in this place
verses.literalPt: Então disse eu: Ah! Senhor DEUS, eis que os profetas lhes dizem: Não vereis espada, e não tereis fome; antes vos darei paz verdadeira neste lugar.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י שֶׁ֚קֶר הַנְּבִאִים֙ נִבְּאִ֣ים בִּשְׁמִ֔י לֹ֤א שְׁלַחְתִּים֙ וְלֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א דִבַּ֖רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם חֲז֨וֹן שֶׁ֜קֶר וְקֶ֤סֶם וֶאֱלוּל וְתַרְמוּת לִבָּ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay še·qer han·nə·ḇi·’îm nib·bə·’îm biš·mî lō šə·laḥ·tîm wə·lō ṣiw·wî·ṯîm wə·lō ḏib·bar·tî ’ă·lê·hem ḥă·zō·wn še·qer wə·qe·sem wɛ·ʾɛ̆·lūl wə·ṯar·mūṯ lib·bām hêm·māh miṯ·nab·bə·’îm lā·ḵem
verses.literal: The prophets are prophesying lies in My name replied the LORD I did not send them or appoint them or speak to them They are prophesying to you a false vision a worthless divination the futility and delusion of their own minds
verses.literalPt: E disse-me o SENHOR: Os profetas profetizam falsamente no meu nome; nunca os enviei, nem lhes dei ordem, nem lhes falei; visão falsa, e adivinhação, e vaidade, e o engano do seu coração é o que eles vos profetizam.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַֽל־ הַנְּבִאִ֞ים הַנִּבְּאִ֣ים בִּשְׁמִי֮ וַאֲנִ֣י לֹֽא־ שְׁלַחְתִּים֒ וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ אֹֽמְרִ֔ים חֶ֣רֶב וְרָעָ֔ב לֹ֥א יִהְיֶ֖ה בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את בַּחֶ֤רֶב וּבָֽרָעָב֙ יִתַּ֔מּוּ הַנְּבִאִ֖ים הָהֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- han·nə·ḇi·’îm han·nib·bə·’îm biš·mî wa·’ă·nî lō- šə·laḥ·tîm wə·hêm·māh ’ō·mə·rîm ḥe·reḇ wə·rā·‘āḇ lō yih·yeh bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ba·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇā·rā·‘āḇ yit·tam·mū han·nə·ḇi·’îm hā·hêm·māh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says about the prophets who prophesy in My name I did not send them yet they say No sword or famine will touch this land By sword and famine these very prophets will meet their end
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR acerca dos profetas que profetizam no meu nome, sem que eu os tenha mandado, e que dizem: Nem espada, nem fome haverá nesta terra: À espada e à fome, serão consumidos esses profetas.

verses.original: וְהָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֣מָּה נִבְּאִ֣ים לָהֶ֡ם יִֽהְי֣וּ מֻשְׁלָכִים֩ בְּחֻצ֨וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם מִפְּנֵ֣י׀ הָרָעָ֣ב וְהַחֶ֗רֶב וְאֵ֤ין מְקַבֵּר֙ לָהֵ֔מָּה הֵ֣מָּה נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְנֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם וְשָׁפַכְתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אֶת־ רָעָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- hêm·māh nib·bə·’îm lā·hem yih·yū muš·lā·ḵîm bə·ḥu·ṣō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim mip·pə·nê hā·rā·‘āḇ wə·ha·ḥe·reḇ wə·’ên mə·qab·bêr lā·hêm·māh hêm·māh nə·šê·hem ū·ḇə·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nō·ṯê·hem wə·šā·p̄aḵ·tî ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- rā·‘ā·ṯām
verses.literal: And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown into the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and sword There will be no one to bury them or their wives their sons or their daughters I will pour out their own evil upon them
verses.literalPt: E o povo a quem eles profetizam será lançado nas ruas de Jerusalém, por causa da fome e da espada; e não haverá quem os sepultem, tanto a eles, como as suas mulheres, e os seus filhos e as suas filhas; porque derramarei sobre eles a sua maldade.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה תֵּרַ֨דְנָה עֵינַ֥י דִּמְעָ֛ה לַ֥יְלָה וְיוֹמָ֖ם וְאַל־ תִּדְמֶ֑ינָה כִּי֩ שֶׁ֨בֶר גָּד֜וֹל נִשְׁבְּרָ֗ה בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת־ עַמִּ֔י מַכָּ֖ה נַחְלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh tê·raḏ·nāh ‘ê·nay dim·‘āh lay·lāh wə·yō·w·mām wə·’al- tiḏ·me·nāh kî še·ḇer gā·ḏō·wl niš·bə·rāh bə·ṯū·laṯ baṯ- ‘am·mî mak·kāh naḥ·lāh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: You are to speak this word to them My eyes overflow with tears day and night they do not cease for the virgin daughter of my people has been shattered by a crushing blow a severely grievous wound
verses.literalPt: Portanto lhes dirás esta palavra: Os meus olhos derramem lágrimas de noite e de dia, e não cessem; porque a virgem, filha do meu povo, está gravemente ferida, de chaga mui dolorosa.

verses.original: אִם־ יָצָ֣אתִי הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב וְאִם֙ בָּ֣אתִי הָעִ֔יר וְהִנֵּ֖ה תַּחֲלוּאֵ֣י רָעָ֑ב כִּֽי־ גַם־ נָבִ֧יא גַם־ כֹּהֵ֛ן סָחֲר֥וּ אֶל־ אֶ֖רֶץ וְלֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- yā·ṣā·ṯî haś·śā·ḏeh wə·hin·nêh ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ wə·’im bā·ṯî hā·‘îr wə·hin·nêh ta·ḥă·lū·’ê rā·‘āḇ kî- ḡam- nā·ḇî ḡam- kō·hên sā·ḥă·rū ’el- ’e·reṣ wə·lō yā·ḏā·‘ū
verses.literal: If I go out to the country I see those slain by the sword if I enter the city I see those ravaged by famine For both prophet and priest travel to a land they do not know
verses.literalPt: Se eu saio ao campo, eis ali os mortos à espada, e, se entro na cidade, estão ali os debilitados pela fome; e até os profetas e os sacerdotes percorrem uma terra, que não conhecem.

verses.original: הֲמָאֹ֨ס מָאַ֜סְתָּ אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֗ה אִם־ בְּצִיּוֹן֙ גָּעֲלָ֣ה נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ מַדּ֙וּעַ֙ הִכִּיתָ֔נוּ וְאֵ֥ין לָ֖נוּ מַרְפֵּ֑א קַוֵּ֤ה לְשָׁלוֹם֙ וְאֵ֣ין ט֔וֹב וּלְעֵ֥ת מַרְפֵּ֖א וְהִנֵּ֥ה בְעָתָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·mā·’ōs mā·’as·tā ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’im- bə·ṣî·yō·wn gā·‘ă·lāh nap̄·še·ḵā mad·dū·a‘ hik·kî·ṯā·nū wə·’ên lā·nū mar·pê qaw·wêh lə·šā·lō·wm wə·’ên ṭō·wḇ ū·lə·‘êṯ mar·pê wə·hin·nêh ḇə·‘ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Have You rejected Judah completely . . . Do You despise Zion Why have You stricken us so that we are beyond healing We hoped for peace but no good has come and for the time of healing but there was only terror
verses.literalPt: Porventura já de todo rejeitaste a Judá? Ou repugna a tua alma a Sião? Por que nos feriste de tal modo que já não há cura para nós? Aguardamos a paz, e não aparece o bem; e o tempo da cura, e eis aqui turbação.

verses.original: יָדַ֧עְנוּ יְהוָ֛ה רִשְׁעֵ֖נוּ עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏa‘·nū Yah·weh riš·‘ê·nū ‘ă·wōn ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū kî ḥā·ṭā·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: We acknowledge our wickedness O LORD the guilt of our fathers indeed we have sinned against You
verses.literalPt: Ah! SENHOR! conhecemos a nossa impiedade e a maldade de nossos pais; porque pecamos contra ti.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּנְאַץ֙ לְמַ֣עַן שִׁמְךָ֔ אַל־ תְּנַבֵּ֖ל כִּסֵּ֣א כְבוֹדֶ֑ךָ זְכֹ֕ר אַל־ תָּפֵ֥ר בְּרִֽיתְךָ֖ אִתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tin·’aṣ lə·ma·‘an šim·ḵā ’al- tə·nab·bêl kis·sê ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏe·ḵā zə·ḵōr ’al- tā·p̄êr bə·rî·ṯə·ḵā ’it·tā·nū
verses.literal: For the sake of Your name do not despise us do not disgrace Your glorious throne Remember Your covenant with us do not break it
verses.literalPt: Não nos rejeites por amor do teu nome; não abatas o trono da tua glória; lembra-te, e não anules a tua aliança conosco.

verses.original: הֲיֵ֨שׁ בְּהַבְלֵ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ מַגְשִׁמִ֔ים וְאִם־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִתְּנ֣וּ רְבִבִ֑ים הֲלֹ֨א אַתָּה־ ה֜וּא יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּ֨נְקַוֶּה־ לָּ֔ךְ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתָ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·yêš bə·haḇ·lê hag·gō·w·yim maḡ·ši·mîm wə·’im- haš·šā·ma·yim yit·tə·nū rə·ḇi·ḇîm hă·lō ’at·tāh- hū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ū·nə·qaw·weh- lāḵ kî- ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: Can the worthless idols of the nations bring rain Do the skies alone send showers Is this not by You . . . O LORD our God So we put our hope in You for You have done all these things
verses.literalPt: Porventura há, entre as vaidades dos gentios, alguém que faça chover? Ou podem os céus dar chuvas? Não és tu, ó SENHOR nosso Deus? Portanto em ti esperamos, pois tu fazes todas estas coisas.
